login.title: Mandatory Identification
login.subtitle: Every citizen must be known to the State. Log in with Google or with your email to confirm your loyalty.
login.disclaimer: By logging in you consent to being observed, catalogued, and, if necessary, re-educated.
login.errorLink: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one, citizen.

errors.email_not_confirmed: This address has not been verified yet. Follow the link in your inbox first.
errors.user_already_exists: This address is already on file. Log in or reset your password.
errors.weak_password: That password is too weak for the State's standards.
errors.over_email_send_rate_limit: Too many emails requested. Wait a while and try again.
errors.invalid_username: That username is not acceptable. Use 3–20 letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again, citizen.
